name: org.bctrainingnavigator/bc-training
title: BC Training Navigator — Grants & PTIRU College Directory
description: Search PTIRU-accredited BC career colleges, training programs, and WorkBC/StudentAid BC grants.

tools.name: check_bc_funding_eligibility
tools.description: Assess an individual's eligibility for British Columbia government-funded career training programs, including WorkBC Skills Training (up to 100% tuition + living supports), StudentAid BC non-repayable grants & 0% loans, StrongerBC Future Skills Grant (up to $3,500), and SkilledTradesBC apprenticeship grants. Use this tool when a user asks whether they qualify for free or subsidized career training in BC. Returns matched funding programs, eligibility notes, and official guide URLs.

employment_status.description: Current employment situation in British Columbia: 'unemployed' (out of work / EI-eligible), 'underemployed' (part-time or low-wage seeking upskilling), 'employed' (working full-time), or 'newcomer' (recent immigrant/refugee).

residency.description: Canadian immigration or residency status: 'citizen' (Canadian citizen), 'pr' (Permanent Resident / Protected Person), 'work_permit' (temporary work permit holder), or 'international_student'.

career_field.description: Optional target career or industry (e.g., 'healthcare', 'HCA', 'ECE', 'IT', 'trades', 'electrician', 'trucking'). Used to surface sector-specific grants such as SkilledTradesBC.

tools.name: search_ptiru_colleges
tools.description: Search the live directory of PTIRU-accredited (Private Training Institutions Regulatory Unit) private career colleges across British Columbia (e.g., Vancouver, Surrey, Burnaby, Richmond, Victoria, Kelowna). Use this tool when a user wants to verify whether a BC college is accredited or StudentAid BC designated. Returns up to 12 matching colleges with city, StudentAid designation status, PTIRU certification status, and direct profile URLs.

city.description: Optional BC city filter (case-insensitive substring match, e.g., 'Vancouver', 'Surrey', 'Burnaby', 'Richmond', 'Victoria', 'Kelowna').

keyword.description: Optional college name keyword (case-insensitive substring match, e.g., 'Sprott Shaw', 'CDI', 'Stenberg', 'Vancouver Career').

tools.name: search_bc_training_programs
tools.description: Search accredited vocational, diploma, and certificate training programs offered by BC career colleges by keyword or category (e.g., Health Care Assistant, Early Childhood Education, Practical Nursing, IT, Electrician). Use this tool when a user asks about program tuition ranges, duration, StudentAid BC designation, or where to study a specific trade/career in BC. Returns up to 12 matching programs with school name, city, duration, tuition range, and direct URLs.

keyword.description: Required program title or career category keyword (e.g., 'Health Care Assistant', 'HCA', 'Early Childhood Education', 'ECE', 'Electrician', 'Cybersecurity').

city.description: Optional BC city filter to narrow results to local campuses (e.g., 'Vancouver', 'Surrey', 'Burnaby', 'Victoria').
